messages:
jia: Postmortem follow-up — capturing remediation owners and short timelines for rollout/flag hardening after yesterday's degraded deploy. Keeping this thread as the single-source action tracker.

omar: thanks. high-level ask: reduce blast radius + make auto-rollback predictable.

lina: I'll own the flag scope changes (region + team scoping). plan: add manifest validation and runtime enforcement. ETA: 2026-01-10.

ben: I'll take the auto-rollback tuning. proposal: two-tier thresholds — soft alert, then hard rollback. soft = 20% error delta for 15m, hard = 50% for 5m OR sustained 3x p95 latency for 10m.

sam: re: sampling: drop traffic to 0.2% for suspect paths while patching. owner: sam. ETA: 48h.

jia: please add tickets and PR links in comments. We'll need test plans + monitors before any rollout.

omar: quick note: add a grace policy to avoid rolling back during infra noise. suggestion: require 2/3 consecutive evaluation windows.

lina: ack. also adding a per-flag "emergency-kill" boolean that bypasses gradual rollout when flipped. runtime semantics: immediate full-off.

ben: minor implementation detail for rollout API (flag manifest):

```
flag_scope: {
  \"regions\": [\"eu-west-1\", \"us-east-1\"],
  \"teams\": [\"payments\", \"search\"],
  \"emergency_kill\": false
}
```

ben: will PR the schema and add server-side enforcement. ETA: Tue EOD.

sam: test plan: synthetic traffic + mutation tests + rollback chaos. will post checklist.

jia: action items (compact):
- lina: implement flag scope + emergency_kill -> owner lina -> ETA 2026-01-10 -> ticket INF-5012
- ben: rollout API + manifest enforcement -> owner ben -> ETA 2025-12-16 -> ticket INF-5013
- sam: canary sampling reduction + tests -> owner sam -> ETA 2025-12-14 -> ticket TEST-221
- ben: auto-rollback policy implementation -> owner ben -> ETA 2025-12-18 -> ticket OPS-909

omar: can we also add a recurring "rollout health" audit: 2-week window that searches for repeating patterns (config flips, throttling spikes)? owner: omar. cadence: bi-weekly.

jia: yes. add to postmortem doc and mark as recurring.

lina: security check: emergency_kill flip should be gated by RBAC + audit log. tagging @security for review.

sam: small ops note: ensure rollback has a manual cooldown to prevent flip-flopping: after rollback, block re-rollout for 30m unless manually overridden.

ops-bot: INFO: new rollout-policy branch created: github.com/redwood/inference/rollout-policy/PR-782 at 14:22 UTC.

jia: next steps: please react with :white_check_mark: when you've created tickets and PRs. we'll meet Thursday sync to confirm blockers. short-term priority = sampling reduction + test harness.

ben: :white_check_mark: PR opened, linked in ticket.

sam: :white_check_mark: ticket created, test plan draft in comments.

lina: :white_check_mark: RFC in drive and ticket linked.

jia: thanks — I'll compile owner updates into the postmortem and schedule the bi-weekly audit on the calendar.

omar: one last ask: include a simple runbook snippet in each ticket describing manual rollback steps (CLI commands + who to page). small example below — please copy to tickets:

```
# manual rollback
redwood rollout cancel --id $ROLL_ID
redwood flag set --name risky_flag --emergency_kill true
page oncall@pagerduty
```

jia: perfect. closing loop here. will reconvene Thu.
